items.t: Transmission slips, flares or shifts harshly
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid or valve body; rebuild if clutches are burned
items.note: A remanufactured transmission runs about $1,500-$2,800 in parts plus 6-8 hours if the damage is internal.

items.t: Transmission drops into neutral at highway speed
items.job: Replace transmission control valve body

items.t: Transmission fluid leak
items.job: Replace leaking transaxle seal or gasket

items.t: Oil pan leak that keeps coming back
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket using revised procedure

items.t: Oil leak at the rear of the engine
items.job: Replace rear main seal (transmission removal)
items.note: Most of the cost is labor to separate the transmission.

items.t: Coolant leak near the throttle body
items.job: Replace upper intake manifold and gaskets

items.t: Water pump leaks or fails
items.job: Replace water pump

items.t: Rusted floor under the battery
items.job: Repair floor pan corrosion in battery compartment

items.t: Rusted front subframe
items.job: Replace front subframe (cradle)

items.t: Transaxle growl for a few minutes after starting
items.job: Diagnose transaxle noise and apply bulletin repair

items.t: Grinding noise in Park on a hill
items.job: Diagnose and apply transaxle noise bulletin

items.t: Steering moans when parking
items.job: Flush power steering fluid or apply bulletin repair

items.t: Shake or vibration at highway speed
items.job: Road-force balance or replace tires

items.t: Chuggle or surge on light throttle
items.job: Diagnose and apply driveability bulletin

items.t: ABS or traction control light on
items.job: Diagnose ABS and replace wheel speed sensor or ABS module

items.t: Front brake noise
items.job: Replace front brake pads and resurface or replace rotors

items.t: Won't start because of the anti-theft key
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder or repair anti-theft wiring

items.t: Trunk lid won't close all the way
items.job: Replace trunk pull-down switch or motor

items.t: Heated seat stops warming
items.job: Replace seat heating element

items.t: Fuel smell from leaking fuel lines or tank
items.job: Replace fuel lines or fuel tank

items.t: Engine dies at highway speed
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor or ignition module

items.t: Engine backfire can crack the intake (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine computer (recall 96V116000)

items.t: Seat belt and key chimes may not work (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace body module (recall 95V204000)

items.t: Seat belt won't latch or retract
items.job: Replace seat belt buckle or retractor

items.t: Steering column loose or clicking
items.job: Tighten or repair tilt steering column

items.t: Battery runs down over a few days
items.job: Parasitic drain test and repair

items.t: Power door locks stop working
items.job: Replace door lock actuator

items.t: Clunk or rattle from the front over bumps
items.job: Replace worn stabilizer link or mount

items.t: Popping noise inside the car
items.job: Apply popping noise bulletin repair
